github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Always format commit messages following Conventional Commits: `<type>(<scope>): <short summary>`.

The scope is strictly MANDATORY (never omit it). The scope must be the current package name being modified (e.g. `signal`, `nanolib`, `core`), inferred from the package directory or package.json. If changes affect root or general configuration, use the relevant concept.

The type must be exactly one of: feat (new feature), fix (bug fix), refactor (code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature), perf (performance improvement), docs (documentation only), lint (formatting, white-space, missing semi-colons, lint rules without logic changes), chore (other changes that don't modify src, e.g. tooling, deps), merge (merge branches, solve conflict), release (release new version).
The short summary must be in imperative present tense (e.g. 'add' not 'added' or 'adds'), all lowercase (do not capitalize the first letter), and must not end with a period.
If changes introduce a breaking change, include a blank line after the summary followed by `BREAKING CHANGE: <description>`.
